checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We've sent you a sign-in link and code. Open the link on this device, or enter the code below.

emailCode.label: Sign-in code
emailCode.description: Opened the email on another device or browser? Enter the code from it here.

linkFailed.title: This sign-in link didn't work
linkFailed.description: Sign-in links work once, and only in the browser where you asked for them. Started on another device or browser? Go back there, request a new email and enter the code from it.

validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: You are signed in. Build your first feature here.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes your account and all of its data. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.label: Type {email} to confirm
deleteDialog.error: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again.
deleteDialog.successDescription: Your account and its data have been deleted.
